dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「遅くなってすいません」
dialogues.en: "I'm sorry, I'm late."
dialogues.text: "I'm sorry, I'm late."

dialogues.jp: 商店街の、喫茶店前。
dialogues.en: At the shopping district, in front of the coffeeshop.
dialogues.text: At the shopping district, in front of the coffeeshop.

dialogues.jp: 今日は珍しく、環の方が遅れてきた。
dialogues.en: Oddly, this time it was Tamaki who got here last.
dialogues.text: Oddly, this time it was Tamaki who got here last.

dialogues.jp: 「いや、今来たところだから」
dialogues.en: "It's okay, I just got here."
dialogues.text: "It's okay, I just got here."

dialogues.jp: この台詞は本当だ。
dialogues.en: It was true, too.
dialogues.text: It was true, too.

dialogues.jp: 俺も環が来る３０秒前に着いたところだった。
dialogues.en: I'd arrived there just 30 seconds before Tamaki did.
dialogues.text: I'd arrived there just 30 seconds before Tamaki did.

dialogues.jp:
しかし、この言葉が言えるのは、なかなか気持
ちがいい。
dialogues.en:
Despite that though, being able to say such words was a good
feeling.
dialogues.text:
Despite that though, being able to say such words was a good
feeling.

dialogues.jp: あれ？
dialogues.en: Hrm?
dialogues.text: Hrm?

dialogues.jp: 環、少し顔色がよくない。
dialogues.en: Tamaki looked a little pale.
dialogues.text: Tamaki looked a little pale.

dialogues.jp: 「環？　どうかしたのか？」
dialogues.en: "Tamaki? Is everything okay?"
dialogues.text: "Tamaki? Is everything okay?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.en: "Ehh?"
dialogues.text: "Ehh?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「なんか、顔色があまりよくないからさ」
dialogues.en: "You don't look well today."
dialogues.text: "You don't look well today."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「そうですか？　大丈夫ですよ」
dialogues.en: "Is that so? I'm fine..."
dialogues.text: "Is that so? I'm fine..."

dialogues.jp: と、言いながらも、少し辛そうに見える。
dialogues.en: But, she couldn't look at me directly while saying that.
dialogues.text: But, she couldn't look at me directly while saying that.

dialogues.jp: 「俺にまで無理するなよ」
dialogues.en: "You don't have to push yourself for me."
dialogues.text: "You don't have to push yourself for me."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「……実は、今朝、頭痛がして……」
dialogues.en: "...I had a headache this morning..."
dialogues.text: "...I had a headache this morning..."

dialogues.jp: そうか。
dialogues.en: Ahh.
dialogues.text: Ahh.

dialogues.jp: だから遅れたのか。
dialogues.en: That's why she was late.
dialogues.text: That's why she was late.

dialogues.jp: 「どうする？　今日止めておくか？」
dialogues.en: "Should we call off today, then?"
dialogues.text: "Should we call off today, then?"

dialogues.jp: と、俺が言うと、環は首を大きく振って、
dialogues.en: At my suggestion, she shook her head fiercely.
dialogues.text: At my suggestion, she shook her head fiercely.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「ぜんっぜん、大丈夫です！」
dialogues.en: "I'm totally fine!"
dialogues.text: "I'm totally fine!"

dialogues.jp: と笑顔で返す。
dialogues.en: And gave me her best smile.
dialogues.text: And gave me her best smile.

dialogues.jp:
そこまで言われると、無下に断ることもできな
くなるな……。いちおう大丈夫だって言ってる
し。
dialogues.en:
Well, if she puts it that way, I can't refuse.. it should
probably be fine.
dialogues.text:
Well, if she puts it that way, I can't refuse.. it should
probably be fine.

dialogues.jp:
空の下を歩いているだけで、体調がよくなるか
もしれないし。
dialogues.en: A slow walk under the clouds might even help her health.
dialogues.text: A slow walk under the clouds might even help her health.

dialogues.jp: 「じゃ、行くか？　どこがいい？」
dialogues.en: "Well, then where would you like to go?"
dialogues.text: "Well, then where would you like to go?"

dialogues.jp:
あまり、よくないようだったら、その時にやめ
ればいいかな。
dialogues.en: If things get worse, I'd stop it then.
dialogues.text: If things get worse, I'd stop it then.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「そうですね……。今日は、普通の女の子のよ
　うなことがしてみたいです」
dialogues.en: "Hmm... I would like to behave like a normal girl today."
dialogues.text: "Hmm... I would like to behave like a normal girl today."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「普通？　普通ってなんだよ」
dialogues.en: "Normal? What do you mean by normal?"
dialogues.text: "Normal? What do you mean by normal?"

dialogues.jp: 何が普通で、何が普通でないかの判断に苦しむ。
dialogues.en: It's not easy to judge what's normal and what's not.
dialogues.text: It's not easy to judge what's normal and what's not.

dialogues.jp: 環にとっても、何が普通なのか疑問だ。
dialogues.en: So it was better to get her own opinion of it, but...
dialogues.text: So it was better to get her own opinion of it, but...

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「うーん。普通が何かよくわからないので、わ
　からないのですが……」
dialogues.en: "Um... I'm not sure myself what exactly "normal" is..."
dialogues.text: "Um... I'm not sure myself what exactly "normal" is..."

dialogues.jp: やっぱり。
dialogues.en: Just as I thought.
dialogues.text: Just as I thought.

dialogues.jp: 「だけど、何でそんなに普通に憧れるの？」
dialogues.en: "Why are you so concerned about normality?"
dialogues.text: "Why are you so concerned about normality?"

dialogues.jp:
まあ、何となく理由は分からなくも無いが、あ
らためて聞いてみる。
dialogues.en: I knew the answer already, but for confirmation...
dialogues.text: I knew the answer already, but for confirmation...

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「だって、わたくし……」
dialogues.en: "Because, I..."
dialogues.text: "Because, I..."

dialogues.jp: 環は恥ずかしそうに俯く。
dialogues.en: Tamaki hung her head in shame.
dialogues.text: Tamaki hung her head in shame.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「いつも家族で行くところは、たいてい神社ば
　かりで……。あまり、経験ないんです」
dialogues.en:
"Most of my life has been spent inside a shrine... I am very
inexperienced in terms of the outside world."
dialogues.text:
"Most of my life has been spent inside a shrine... I am very
inexperienced in terms of the outside world."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「だから、普通のお家みたいに、お出かけした
　ことがなくて」
dialogues.en:
"My relatives were all shrine-related as well, so I'd never
seen a normal household."
dialogues.text:
"My relatives were all shrine-related as well, so I'd never
seen a normal household."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「何となく、普通っていいなって、憧れてたん
　です」
dialogues.en:
"I somehow think that being normal would be better, and
more... fun."
dialogues.text:
"I somehow think that being normal would be better, and
more... fun."

dialogues.jp: そっか……。
dialogues.en: I see...
dialogues.text: I see...

dialogues.jp:
俺や普通の人にとって当たり前のことでも、環
にとっては新鮮に映ることもあるのかもしれな
い。
dialogues.en:
The things I treated as normal and standard, were things
that Tamaki knew precious little about.
dialogues.text:
The things I treated as normal and standard, were things
that Tamaki knew precious little about.

dialogues.jp: 環は、俺に少し、ねだるように、俯いて言う。
dialogues.en: Still a little embarassed, she continued.
dialogues.text: Still a little embarassed, she continued.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「朝倉様のオススメスポットに連れて行ってほ
　しいです」
dialogues.en:
"I'd like to see a place which you'd recommend,
Asakura-sama."
dialogues.text:
"I'd like to see a place which you'd recommend,
Asakura-sama."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「オススメ？」
dialogues.en: "My recommendation?"
dialogues.text: "My recommendation?"

dialogues.jp: オススメか。
dialogues.en: Hmm...
dialogues.text: Hmm...

dialogues.jp:
俺が遊ぶんだったらゲーセンだけど、女の子に
は……どうなんだろう？
dialogues.en:
My most frequented place around here is the arcade... would
girls really... take to that?
dialogues.text:
My most frequented place around here is the arcade... would
girls really... take to that?

dialogues.jp: あと、思いつくものというと……。
dialogues.en: It doesn't seem... right, somehow.
dialogues.text: It doesn't seem... right, somehow.

dialogues.jp: 俺自信、デートの経験が多いわけではない。
dialogues.en: I'm no expert in the field of dating either.
dialogues.text: I'm no expert in the field of dating either.

dialogues.jp:
こういうときの、レパートリーは少ない、と言
える。
dialogues.en:
In this kind of situation, I should just fess up to my
inexperience.
dialogues.text:
In this kind of situation, I should just fess up to my
inexperience.

dialogues.jp: だけど、せっかくの環のリクエストだ。
dialogues.en: But it's a request from Tamaki...
dialogues.text: But it's a request from Tamaki...

dialogues.jp: よし、今回は……ベタだけど……。
dialogues.en: Alright... even if it's weird...
dialogues.text: Alright... even if it's weird...

dialogues.jp: 「じゃ、普通っぽく、遊園地でも行きますか」
dialogues.en: "Let's go to the amusement park, then."
dialogues.text: "Let's go to the amusement park, then."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「遊園地？」
dialogues.en: "Amusement park?"
dialogues.text: "Amusement park?"

dialogues.jp: 環は一瞬、不思議そうな顔をする。
dialogues.en: Tamaki was perplexed by my response.
dialogues.text: Tamaki was perplexed by my response.

dialogues.jp: やっぱり、定番すぎたかな……。
dialogues.en: Maybe that was too much...
dialogues.text: Maybe that was too much...

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「それって、どんなところなんですか？」
dialogues.en: "What kind of place would that be?"
dialogues.text: "What kind of place would that be?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.en: "Eh?"
dialogues.text: "Eh?"

dialogues.jp: 意外な回答が返ってくる。
dialogues.en: Not the question I was expecting.
dialogues.text: Not the question I was expecting.

dialogues.jp: 今時、遊園地を知らないなんて……。
dialogues.en: To not know what amusement parks are in this day and age...
dialogues.text: To not know what amusement parks are in this day and age...

dialogues.jp: 俺は環を甘く見ていたのかもしれない。
dialogues.en:
She's not one to be underestimated... or is it
overestimated?
dialogues.text:
She's not one to be underestimated... or is it
overestimated?

dialogues.jp:
「ほら、観覧車とか、メリーゴーランドとか
　……」
dialogues.en: "It's a place with ferris wheels, and merry-go-rounds..."
dialogues.text: "It's a place with ferris wheels, and merry-go-rounds..."

dialogues.jp:
まさか、遊園地について説明することになると
は思わなかった。
dialogues.en:
I never thought I'd ever have to explain what an amusement
park is.
dialogues.text:
I never thought I'd ever have to explain what an amusement
park is.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「ああ、遊園地といいますと、あの噂に聞く
　……」
dialogues.en: "Ahh, I have heard of it then... it sounds good."
dialogues.text: "Ahh, I have heard of it then... it sounds good."

dialogues.jp: しかし、俺の説明で環は納得したらしく、
dialogues.en: Semes like she understood it, though.
dialogues.text: Semes like she understood it, though.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「そういえば、話には聞いたことがあります。
　まるで、おとぎの国みたいなんでしょ？」
dialogues.en:
"The ones I heard of are grand, though... as if they were
from other countries?"
dialogues.text:
"The ones I heard of are grand, though... as if they were
from other countries?"

dialogues.jp: と、喜々として笑う。
dialogues.en: She smiled a little.
dialogues.text: She smiled a little.

dialogues.jp: 「そんなたいそうなものじゃないけどね」
dialogues.en: "It's not that big a place."
dialogues.text: "It's not that big a place."

dialogues.jp: 俺は思わず笑ってしまう。
dialogues.en: I laughed a little at her innocence.
dialogues.text: I laughed a little at her innocence.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「わたくし、一度も行ったことが無いんです！
　ぜひ行きましょう！」
dialogues.en:
"Regardless, it is someplace I've not been to before! Please
take me there!"
dialogues.text:
"Regardless, it is someplace I've not been to before! Please
take me there!"

dialogues.jp: 環の声は、ウキウキと弾んでいる。
dialogues.en: Tamaki's voice was cheerful and bright.
dialogues.text: Tamaki's voice was cheerful and bright.

dialogues.jp: 今時、こういうリアクションも珍しいよな。
dialogues.en: That kind of reaction from her was unexpected.
dialogues.text: That kind of reaction from her was unexpected.

dialogues.jp:
男にとっては、こんなに楽しみにしてもらうと、
連れていきがいもある。
dialogues.en:
Any guy would be delighted to have this sort of companion
with them.
dialogues.text:
Any guy would be delighted to have this sort of companion
with them.

dialogues.jp: 「じゃ、決まりな」
dialogues.en: "It's decided, then."
dialogues.text: "It's decided, then."

dialogues.jp: 俺は環の手を引き、遊園地に向かった。
dialogues.en:
I took her by the hand, and we headed for the amusement
park.
dialogues.text:
I took her by the hand, and we headed for the amusement
park.

dialogues.jp: 遊園地からの帰り、俺は神社に環を送る。
dialogues.en: We exited the amusement park, and I walked Tamaki home.
dialogues.text: We exited the amusement park, and I walked Tamaki home.

dialogues.jp: もう、辺りはすっかり遅くなっていた。
dialogues.en: It'd gotten dark before we knew it.
dialogues.text: It'd gotten dark before we knew it.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「あー。楽しかった」
dialogues.en: "Ahhh, that was fun!"
dialogues.text: "Ahhh, that was fun!"

dialogues.jp: 石段を上りきると、環が笑顔で言う。
dialogues.en:
She said as we ascended the stone steps, a big smile on her
face.
dialogues.text:
She said as we ascended the stone steps, a big smile on her
face.

dialogues.jp: 二人は、｛まき／槙｝の木の下まで歩いてくる。
dialogues.en: We continued on walking, towards the kozue tree.
dialogues.text: We continued on walking, towards the kozue tree.

dialogues.jp: 「そうだな」
dialogues.en: "Wasn't it?"
dialogues.text: "Wasn't it?"

dialogues.jp: 本当に、楽しかった。
dialogues.en: It was really enjoyable.
dialogues.text: It was really enjoyable.

dialogues.jp: 家族で行くのとは違った楽しみがある。
dialogues.en: Certainly much different from visiting other shrines.
dialogues.text: Certainly much different from visiting other shrines.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「遊園地って、本当に素敵なところですね」
dialogues.en: "An amusement park is certainly a wonderful place."
dialogues.text: "An amusement park is certainly a wonderful place."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「子供達の夢が、いっぱい詰まってて、楽しかっ
　たです」
dialogues.en:
"It is like an amalgamation of every kid's dream, a
wonderland."
dialogues.text:
"It is like an amalgamation of every kid's dream, a
wonderland."

dialogues.jp: よかった。
dialogues.en: It's a relief...
dialogues.text: It's a relief...

dialogues.jp:
やっぱり、楽しいって言ってもらえると、プロ
デュースしたかいもある。
dialogues.en: That she enjoyed my idea a lot in the end.
dialogues.text: That she enjoyed my idea a lot in the end.

dialogues.jp: 「そういえば、もう頭痛はいいのか？」
dialogues.en: "By the way, how's your headache?"
dialogues.text: "By the way, how's your headache?"

dialogues.jp:
遊園地の中でも、環は一度だけ頭痛がして、ベ
ンチで休んでいた。
dialogues.en:
While we were at the amusement park, Tamaki suffered a
relapse of her headache, and had to rest at a bench.
dialogues.text:
While we were at the amusement park, Tamaki suffered a
relapse of her headache, and had to rest at a bench.

dialogues.jp:
しかし、その後、遊園地最大の目玉である、４
７度急降下の、ジェットコースターに乗っても
平気な顔をしていたので、
dialogues.en:
Right after that though, she rode the amusement park's main
attraction, the 47km jet coaster...
dialogues.text:
Right after that though, she rode the amusement park's main
attraction, the 47km jet coaster...

dialogues.jp: おそらく大丈夫だと思うが……。
dialogues.en: If she could take that...
dialogues.text: If she could take that...

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「はい。だいぶ良くなりましたよ」
dialogues.en: "I feel perfectly fine now."
dialogues.text: "I feel perfectly fine now."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「また、行きたいですね」
dialogues.en: "Let's go again sometime."
dialogues.text: "Let's go again sometime."

dialogues.jp: 環は笑って答える。
dialogues.en: She answered me with a gleaming smile.
dialogues.text: She answered me with a gleaming smile.

dialogues.jp: 俺はそれを聞いて、安心する。
dialogues.en: Her enthusiasm relieved my worries.
dialogues.text: Her enthusiasm relieved my worries.

dialogues.jp: 「そうだな。また行こう」
dialogues.en: "Yeah, we will."
dialogues.text: "Yeah, we will."

dialogues.jp: そう言って互いに、笑いあう。
dialogues.en: I smiled back at her as well.
dialogues.text: I smiled back at her as well.

dialogues.jp: 「どこが一番よかった？」
dialogues.en: "Which of the attractions did you like the best?"
dialogues.text: "Which of the attractions did you like the best?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「そうですね。やはり、観覧車でしょうか？」
dialogues.en: "Hmm. Probably the ferris wheel."
dialogues.text: "Hmm. Probably the ferris wheel."

dialogues.jp: 観覧車か。
dialogues.en: The ferris wheel, huh.
dialogues.text: The ferris wheel, huh.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「だって、海が見えて、とっても綺麗なんです
　もの」
dialogues.en: "The sea looked so beautiful from such a height."
dialogues.text: "The sea looked so beautiful from such a height."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「そうだな」
dialogues.en: "I see."
dialogues.text: "I see."

dialogues.jp: 初音島は、四方が海だ。
dialogues.en: Hatsu-Nejima's an island surrounded by sea.
dialogues.text: Hatsu-Nejima's an island surrounded by sea.

dialogues.jp:
観覧車のように高いところに行くと、その事実
を思い出す。
dialogues.en:
Sitting on a ferris wheel that takes you to such heights,
it's water blue as far as the eye can see.
dialogues.text:
Sitting on a ferris wheel that takes you to such heights,
it's water blue as far as the eye can see.

dialogues.jp: 遠くの景色を見ながら……。
dialogues.en: Seeing such scenery from afar, together...
dialogues.text: Seeing such scenery from afar, together...

dialogues.jp:
二人で箱の中に揺られていると、幸せな気持ち
になれた。
dialogues.en: It brought happiness to both of us.
dialogues.text: It brought happiness to both of us.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「朝倉様は、何がよかったんですか？」
dialogues.en: "What about you, Asakura-sama? What was your favourite?"
dialogues.text: "What about you, Asakura-sama? What was your favourite?"

dialogues.jp: と、環は今度は俺に振ってきた。
dialogues.en: Tamaki returned my question back at me.
dialogues.text: Tamaki returned my question back at me.

dialogues.jp: 「俺は、オバケ屋敷かな」
dialogues.en: "For me, definitely the haunted house."
dialogues.text: "For me, definitely the haunted house."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「オバケ屋敷ですか？　また、どうして？」
dialogues.en: "The haunted house? Why would that be?"
dialogues.text: "The haunted house? Why would that be?"

dialogues.jp: 環は小首をかしげて、俺に尋ねる。
dialogues.en: Tamaki tilted her haid in confusion.
dialogues.text: Tamaki tilted her haid in confusion.

dialogues.jp:
「ほら、環ったら、巫女のクセにオバケが怖い
　とかいって、俺に抱きついてきたりしてただ
　ろ？」
dialogues.en:
"Because you were so scared of the ghosts, and held onto me
so tightly."
dialogues.text:
"Because you were so scared of the ghosts, and held onto me
so tightly."

dialogues.jp: と、俺は苦笑する。
dialogues.en: I chuckled to myself at the thought.
dialogues.text: I chuckled to myself at the thought.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「え？　それって、ダメなんですか？」
dialogues.en: "Ehh? Was that... bad?"
dialogues.text: "Ehh? Was that... bad?"

dialogues.jp: 環は不思議そうな顔をして聞いてくる。
dialogues.en: She was perplexed at my answer.
dialogues.text: She was perplexed at my answer.

dialogues.jp:
「いや、ダメじゃないし、男としては、そうい
　うのが嬉しいって訳で……」
dialogues.en:
"No, it's not bad... any guy would've loved to be in my
position..."
dialogues.text:
"No, it's not bad... any guy would've loved to be in my
position..."

dialogues.jp: 環の理由に比べると、俺の理由の低俗なこと。
dialogues.en: Compared to her answer, mine was so... vulgar.
dialogues.text: Compared to her answer, mine was so... vulgar.

dialogues.jp: 俺は恥ずかしさを、誤魔化すために笑った。
dialogues.en: I tried to laugh off my embarassment.
dialogues.text: I tried to laugh off my embarassment.

dialogues.jp: 環はまだ不思議そうな顔をしている。
dialogues.en: Which didn't help Tamaki understand things any better.
dialogues.text: Which didn't help Tamaki understand things any better.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「うれしいんですか？」
dialogues.en: "So... you enjoyed it?"
dialogues.text: "So... you enjoyed it?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「そりゃまあ、男はみんな……ハハハ」
dialogues.en: "Well, as I said, any guy would.... hahaha."
dialogues.text: "Well, as I said, any guy would.... hahaha."

dialogues.jp: 俺はますます乾いた笑いをする。
dialogues.en: I pulled off the most fake laugh I'd ever heard.
dialogues.text: I pulled off the most fake laugh I'd ever heard.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「そうですか……」
dialogues.en: "I see..."
dialogues.text: "I see..."

dialogues.jp: 環は、何やら考える仕草をしている。
dialogues.en: Tamaki seemed to be deep in thought about my mixed answer.
dialogues.text: Tamaki seemed to be deep in thought about my mixed answer.

dialogues.jp:
何だか、言わなきゃよかったな。下心がばれて
しまったみたいで、恥ずかしい。
dialogues.en:
Good thing she didn't question further... if she found out
what I meant, it'd be embarassing for sure.
dialogues.text:
Good thing she didn't question further... if she found out
what I meant, it'd be embarassing for sure.

dialogues.jp: 環がさらっと流してくれた方が、気が楽だな。
dialogues.en: Unlike before though, Tamaki's entire mood had changed.
dialogues.text: Unlike before though, Tamaki's entire mood had changed.

dialogues.jp:
環は、俯いてまだ考え込んでいる。別に、そん
なに難しいことでもないんだが。
dialogues.en:
She was a picture of a lone thinker. It wasn't that
difficult to comprehend, was it?
dialogues.text:
She was a picture of a lone thinker. It wasn't that
difficult to comprehend, was it?

dialogues.jp: すると、
dialogues.en: Suddenly,
dialogues.text: Suddenly,

dialogues.jp: 環が突然、俺に抱きついてくる。
dialogues.en: She turned to me and hugged me tightly.
dialogues.text: She turned to me and hugged me tightly.

dialogues.jp: 環の柔らかい身体が、俺の胸に触れる。
dialogues.en: Her warm and soft body rubbed against my chest.
dialogues.text: Her warm and soft body rubbed against my chest.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「うれしいですか？」
dialogues.en: "Are you happy...?"
dialogues.text: "Are you happy...?"

dialogues.jp: 環はささやくように、俺に尋ねる。
dialogues.en: Tamaki quietly whispered.
dialogues.text: Tamaki quietly whispered.

dialogues.en: "U, uhm..."
dialogues.text: "U, uhm..."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「朝倉様？」
dialogues.en: "Asakura-sama...?"
dialogues.text: "Asakura-sama...?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.en: "Yeah..."
dialogues.text: "Yeah..."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「よかった……」
dialogues.en: "That's good..."
dialogues.text: "That's good..."

dialogues.jp: ドキドキと鼓動が速くなってくる。
dialogues.en: Her closeness made my heartbeat jump up several notches.
dialogues.text: Her closeness made my heartbeat jump up several notches.

dialogues.jp: 俺は、環の背中にそっと腕を回す。
dialogues.en: I wrapped my arms around her back.
dialogues.text: I wrapped my arms around her back.

dialogues.jp: 環は俺の胸に顔をうずめて、
dialogues.en: She buried her face into my chest.
dialogues.text: She buried her face into my chest.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「あったかい……」
dialogues.en: "You're warm..."
dialogues.text: "You're warm..."

dialogues.jp: と言う。
dialogues.en: Simple, yet meaningful words.
dialogues.text: Simple, yet meaningful words.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「心臓、ドクドクしてますね」
dialogues.en: "Your heart is beating so fast..."
dialogues.text: "Your heart is beating so fast..."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「聞こえます」
dialogues.en: "I can hear it."
dialogues.text: "I can hear it."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.en: "A, ahh..."
dialogues.text: "A, ahh..."

dialogues.jp: すごく速くて、すごく息苦しい。
dialogues.en: The beating became faster.
dialogues.text: The beating became faster.

dialogues.jp:
なるべく悟られたくないが、こんなに近くにい
たら、無理だ。
dialogues.en:
It'd be impossible to describe or comprehend this feeling I
get when we're so close.
dialogues.text:
It'd be impossible to describe or comprehend this feeling I
get when we're so close.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「こうしてると、なんだか……ほっとします
　……」
dialogues.en: "When we're like this, it feels so... comfortable..."
dialogues.text: "When we're like this, it feels so... comfortable..."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「……そう、かもな」
dialogues.en: "...Yeah, it kinda does."
dialogues.text: "...Yeah, it kinda does."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「不思議ですね……」
dialogues.en: "It's strange..."
dialogues.text: "It's strange..."

dialogues.jp: そんなことも、二人でいなければ気づかない。
dialogues.en: It wasn't the kind of thing we'd notice when we're alone.
dialogues.text: It wasn't the kind of thing we'd notice when we're alone.

dialogues.jp:
二人だから、初めて自分のことを知ることがで
きる。
dialogues.en: Since we were just beginning to understand ourselves too.
dialogues.text: Since we were just beginning to understand ourselves too.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「ずっと、このままだったらいいのに……」
dialogues.en: "If we could just stay here like this forever..."
dialogues.text: "If we could just stay here like this forever..."

dialogues.jp:
近くにいるから聞こえるぐらいの小さな声で、
環がささやく。
dialogues.en: Her whisper fell deeply into my ears.
dialogues.text: Her whisper fell deeply into my ears.

dialogues.jp: 環も、そのまま黙ってしまった。
dialogues.en: Tamaki suddenly fell silent.
dialogues.text: Tamaki suddenly fell silent.

dialogues.en: "...Tamaki?"
dialogues.text: "...Tamaki?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「……何か、見えるのか？」
dialogues.en: "...Did you see something?"
dialogues.text: "...Did you see something?"

dialogues.jp: 俺は不安になって、恐る恐る、俺は環に尋ねる。
dialogues.en: I asked her timidly, fearing her answer.
dialogues.text: I asked her timidly, fearing her answer.

dialogues.jp:
環がまた、何か悩んでいるのなら、力になりた
い。
dialogues.en:
Tamaki was still thinking about something, trying to regain
her strength.
dialogues.text:
Tamaki was still thinking about something, trying to regain
her strength.

dialogues.jp: 俺の問いかけに、環は黙って首を振る。
dialogues.en: Eventually, she shook her head at my question.
dialogues.text: Eventually, she shook her head at my question.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.en: "Nothing..."
dialogues.text: "Nothing..."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「でも、幸せなことって、すぐに逃げちゃう気
　がするから」
dialogues.en: "But it seems like this happiness may fade away..."
dialogues.text: "But it seems like this happiness may fade away..."

dialogues.jp: と、環は俺を抱く手に力を入れる。
dialogues.en: Tamaki buried herself deeper into my arms.
dialogues.text: Tamaki buried herself deeper into my arms.

dialogues.jp:
「何、弱気なこといってんだよ。俺が……ずっ
　とそばにいるよ」
dialogues.en: "Hey, don't be so negative... I'd always be by your side."
dialogues.text: "Hey, don't be so negative... I'd always be by your side."

dialogues.jp: 俺も、環を抱く手に力を入れる。
dialogues.en: I hugged her tighter as well.
dialogues.text: I hugged her tighter as well.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「……そばにいてね……」
dialogues.en: "...By my side, huh..."
dialogues.text: "...By my side, huh..."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「ああ、もちろんだ……」
dialogues.en: "Yeah, definitely..."
dialogues.text: "Yeah, definitely..."

dialogues.jp: この幸せが、ずっと続きますように。
dialogues.en: So that this happiness can last forever.
dialogues.text: So that this happiness can last forever.

dialogues.jp:
そんな環の想いを、受け止めてやりたいと思っ
た。
dialogues.en: To ease her negative thoughts, and show her a bright future.
dialogues.text: To ease her negative thoughts, and show her a bright future.

dialogues.jp: ◆遊園地◆
dialogues.en: ◆Amusement Park?◆
dialogues.text: ◆Amusement Park?◆

dialogues.jp:
遊園地でデートをし、帰ってきた俺は環を神社
へ送る。
dialogues.en:
Tamaki and I had a date at the amusement park. We then
returned to her shrine.
dialogues.text:
Tamaki and I had a date at the amusement park. We then
returned to her shrine.

dialogues.jp:
環がオバケ屋敷を怖がらないと俺が言うと、抱
きついてくれる。
dialogues.en:
When I talked about what happened at the haunted house,
Tamaki suddenly leaned onto me.
dialogues.text:
When I talked about what happened at the haunted house,
Tamaki suddenly leaned onto me.

dialogues.jp:
ずっとこの幸せが続くといいと、あらためて思っ
た。
dialogues.en:
I once again thought how nice it would be, if we could keep
this happiness forever.
dialogues.text:
I once again thought how nice it would be, if we could keep
this happiness forever.
